name: Dice, Loaded
body:
Loaded Dice: These dice are weighted so that they will nearly always roll the same. A person handling the dice, who succeeds on a Perception check, notices they feel off. The base DC for noticing the dice are weighted is 15. The DC may be increased at a ratio of 5 gp per +1 to the DC. (Example: Loaded dice with a Perception DC of 16 would cost 15 gp and those with a DC of 20 would cost 35 gp.) Base Cost 10 gp.
